title: Prevent cancelling orders after shipment
intent: Prevent customers from cancelling orders after shipment.
acceptance_criteria: Cancelling a SHIPPED order is rejected with a clear conflict error
Cancelling a DELIVERED or already-CANCELLED order remains rejected (regression)
Cancelling a PENDING/CONFIRMED/PROCESSING order remains allowed (regression)
expected_risks: Over-broadening the cancel block could incorrectly prevent legitimate cancellations of earlier-stage orders
expected_tests: cancelling a shipped order is rejected
cancelling a delivered order still rejected (regression)
cancelling a pending order still succeeds (regression)
